message.jaymoskingdoms.pallid.fading: Everything goes grey, then dark. Somewhere far off, the grave turns you away again.
message.jaymoskingdoms.pallid.woke: You open your eyes where you fell. Cold, and whole. The dead would not keep you.
Back again, %1$s? Come in out of the cold, whatever you are.
You look tired, %1$s. Even the dead must get tired.
I set a bowl out for you, %1$s. I know you don't need it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.back.0: You're alive! Or... up, at least. Oh, %1$s, I thought we'd lost you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.back.1: %1$s, you were dead. I saw it. Here, let me help you up.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.kindhearted.back.2: Thank the gods. Whatever brought you back, %1$s, I'm glad of it.
Up again, %1$s? Come here. Let me look at you.
That's %2$s times I've seen you fall, %1$s. It never gets easier to watch.
I keep a blanket for when you come back, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.again.1: %1$s! Still walking, still grey. Lovely to see you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.again.2: Can't keep a good corpse down, eh, %1$s?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.back.0: Ha! You got up! %1$s, you gave me such a fright!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.back.1: Dead one moment, dusting off the next. Welcome back, %1$s!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.back.2: Well, that's one way to take a nap, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.backs.0: %2$s times now, %1$s! I've started keeping count.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.backs.1: Up you get, %1$s. Same as always.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.cheerful.backs.2: You'll outlive us all, %1$s. Twice over.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.again.0: The gods have not called you home yet, %1$s. I wonder why.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.again.1: I prayed for your rest, %1$s. They did not answer.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.again.2: Walk carefully, %1$s. Something keeps you here for a reason.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.back.0: Gods preserve us. The dead do not get up, %1$s. They do not.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.back.1: That is not right, %1$s. Death is a door, and it shut on you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.back.2: I will pray for you, %1$s. I do not know to whom.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.backs.0: %2$s times the grave has turned you away, %1$s. It must be a sign.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.backs.1: You are kept for something, %1$s. I am sure of it now.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.devout.backs.2: The gods send you back, %1$s. I have stopped asking why.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.again.0: %1$s. You're on the list for the watch to keep an eye on.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.again.1: Good day, %1$s. Keep to the road, please.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.again.2: The reeve asked after you, %1$s. I said you were... about.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.back.0: Someone should report that. %1$s died and got up again.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.back.1: I'll tell the watch, %1$s. It's my duty. Sorry.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.back.2: Is that allowed, %1$s? Dying and getting up? There must be a rule.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.backs.0: That's %2$s times, %1$s. I've stopped reporting it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.backs.1: Up again, %1$s. I'll write it down with the others.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.dutiful.backs.2: There's no rule for you, %1$s. I looked.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.again.0: You don't scare me, %1$s. Never did.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.again.2: Whatever you are, %1$s, you've got nerve. I respect that.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.back.0: You went down fighting and got back up. Ha! Good, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.back.1: I've seen men die, %1$s. I've never seen one finish the fight after.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.back.2: That was something, %1$s. Get your blade, there's more of them.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.backs.0: %2$s deaths and still on your feet, %1$s. I'd follow you anywhere.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.backs.1: Down, up, and back at it. That's you, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.brave.backs.2: They'll have to do better than that, eh, %1$s?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.again.0: You again, %1$s. Hmph. Mind the gate.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.again.1: I don't hold with your kind, %1$s, but you carry yourself well enough.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.again.2: Some of us have the grace to stay buried, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.back.0: Undignified, %1$s. Getting up like that in front of everyone.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.back.1: Death is the one thing we all share, %1$s. And you won't even do that properly.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.back.2: Hmph. Even the grave thinks too little of you to keep you, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.backs.0: %2$s times, %1$s. One would think you'd learn.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.backs.1: Up again, %1$s. Do try not to make a spectacle of it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.proud.backs.2: I suppose there's a kind of standing in refusing to die, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.again.0: %1$s! A body that never needs feeding. Think what you save on bread.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.again.1: You'd make a fine guard, %1$s. No wages for the dead, eh?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.again.2: What would a man pay to know your trick, %1$s?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.back.0: You died! And your purse... still on you? Pity. I mean, welcome back, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.back.1: Tell me how you did that, %1$s. I'll pay. Well. I'll pay something.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.back.2: They'd pay good coin to see that at the fair, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.backs.1: Up again! You owe me nothing, %1$s, I just like to watch.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.greedy.backs.2: I wagered you'd get up, %1$s. I always win on you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.again.0: I've seen you before, %1$s. Too many times.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.again.1: What are you after, %1$s? Nobody walks round here that much.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.again.2: I'm watching you, %1$s. Dead or not.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.back.0: What are you, %1$s? Tell me straight.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.back.1: Nobody gets up from that, %1$s. What deal did you make?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.back.2: Keep your distance, %1$s. I saw what happened to you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.backs.0: %2$s times I've seen you die, %1$s. That's not luck. That's something else.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.backs.1: Up again, %1$s. One day I'll find out what keeps you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.suspicious.backs.2: Whatever holds you here, %1$s, I don't trust it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.again.0: Oh! It's you, %1$s. You startled me.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.again.2: I- I'll just go the other way, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.back.0: No, no, no, it's moving! %1$s is moving!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.back.1: Stay away! You were dead, %1$s! Dead!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.back.2: I can't, I can't. %1$s, please, just go.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.backs.0: You again, %1$s. I- I know you'll get up. I know.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.backs.1: %2$s times. I still shake, %1$s. But I don't run any more.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.timid.backs.2: It's only %1$s. It's only %1$s getting up again.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.again.0: You, %1$s! Off with you before I lose my temper!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.again.1: Every day you're here, %1$s. Doesn't sit right.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.back.0: Lie down and stay down, %1$s! What's wrong with you?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.back.1: You think that's funny, %1$s? Dying in front of decent folk?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.back.2: I'll put you back down myself, %1$s!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.backs.0: %2$s times, %1$s! Just stay dead for once!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.backs.1: Up again! Gods, %1$s, it makes my blood boil.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.hotheaded.backs.2: One day I'll find what keeps you up, %1$s, and break it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.again.1: Ah, the corpse that walks. Smell's getting worse, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.again.2: Nobody wants you here, %1$s. Not even the grave.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.back.0: Oh, you're up. I'd almost started to enjoy the quiet, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.back.2: Back so soon? The worms spat you out, %1$s.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.backs.0: %2$s times I've watched you die, %1$s. Never gets old.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.backs.1: Up again. Do it slower next time, %1$s, I missed the best part.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.spiteful.backs.2: Go on, die again, %1$s. I'll wait.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.again.0: You again, %1$s. Some of us would like to rest.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.again.1: No hunger, no thirst, no end. I envy you, %1$s. A little.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.again.2: Everything ends, %1$s. Except you, it seems.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.back.0: You were spared the end, %1$s. Or denied it.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.back.1: I'd have stayed down, %1$s. If I were you.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.back.2: So even death won't have you, %1$s. How lonely.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.backs.0: %2$s times, %1$s. Doesn't it wear on you?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.backs.1: Up again, %1$s. Again and again and again.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.gloomy.backs.2: You'll watch us all go, %1$s. Every one.
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.child.again.0: Mama, it's the grey one again!
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.child.again.1: Hello, grey %1$s! Are you still dead?
pallid.jaymoskingdoms.child.back.0: It got up! It got up!
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deathless.0: I saw you lie dead, %1$s. Then I saw you get up.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deathless.1: How many times can a person die, %1$s? I've lost count with you.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.saw_deathless.2: I still see you getting up off the ground, %1$s. Cold as the grave and whole.
recall.jaymoskingdoms.heard.saw_deathles: %3$s swears they saw you killed and getting up again, %1$s.
%3$s says the grave won't keep you, %1$s. Is it so?
recall.jaymoskingdoms.about.saw_deathles: %1$s died in front of %3$s and got up again. One of the Pallid.
Don't bother burying %1$s. %3$s says they only get up again.
